Canton of Bern · Schweiz (Deutsch)

Bern (Bern) — Schweiz Reiseführer: Sehenswürdigkeiten, Anreise & Spezialitäten

UNESCO sandstone arcades, medieval Zytglogge astronomical clock, Rose Garden views and Aare river swims.

Region / KantonCanton of Bern
Beste ReisezeitApr–Jun & Sep–Oct
Stay1–2 days

Überblick

Bern (Bern) is one of the essential stops in Switzerland, located in the Canton of Bern region. UNESCO sandstone arcades, medieval Zytglogge astronomical clock, Rose Garden views and Aare river swims.

With direct connections via SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways, Bern rewards a stay of 1–2 days so you can balance major landmarks with neighborhood cafés, markets, and easy half-day excursions.

Sehenswürdigkeiten & Aktivitäten

  • Bern Historic Center & Main Square: Signature highlight in Bern — reserve morning entry tickets online in peak season.
  • Bern National Museum & Cathedral: Signature highlight in Bern — reserve morning entry tickets online in peak season.
  • Bern Panoramic Viewpoint & Old Quarter: Signature highlight in Bern — reserve morning entry tickets online in peak season.

Lokale Küche & Spezialitäten

  • Traditional Bern House Specialty: Iconic local specialty of Bern and the Canton of Bern region.
  • Regional Canton of Bern Market Dish: Iconic local specialty of Bern and the Canton of Bern region.
  • Artisanal Canton of Bern Pastry & Wine: Iconic local specialty of Bern and the Canton of Bern region.

Anreise & Nahverkehr

Bern is served by SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways and intercity express trains as well as regional airport transfers. Book high-speed legs 2–6 weeks ahead for early-bird fares.

The historic core of Bern is best explored on foot, supplemented by contactless tap-to-pay metro, tram, or bus lines.

Unterkünfte & Viertel

  • Budget: Well-connected hostels and guesthouses within a 10-minute walk of Bern's central station or metro lines.
  • Mid-range: Boutique 3-to-4-star hotels near the historic center and pedestrian promenade.
  • Luxury: Heritage 5-star grand hotels and design properties with concierge access and views.
